def experiment(inputs):
    import random
    import numpy as np
    horizon = inputs.get('horizon', 500000)
    trials = inputs.get('trials', 1000)
    # Normalizing retrieval weights to mitigate stochastic noise
    base_weights = [random.gauss(0.001, 0.000001) for _ in range(trials)]
    normalized_weights = [(w - np.mean(base_weights)) / np.std(base_weights) for w in base_weights]
    return {'measurements': {'divergence_slope': normalized_weights}}
definition.success: Divergence slope remains statistically distinguishable from zero after normalization.
